title: Pin Windows Codex worker spawn environment, profile transitions and serialized profile spelling
outcome: Focused regressions cover the worker-specific spawn PATH decision, thread-less profile reset and existing worker-home mode changes, and the persisted workspaceWriteSandbox spelling. Routing-harness expansion is separately tracked in w-53ab42df726c.
acceptance: A regression exercises the production spawn environment decision for Default, ReadOnlySandbox and WorkspaceWriteSandbox, and would fail if the worker process stopped receiving the filtered PATH.

Regressions cover thread-less delegated profile changes requiring runtime reset, existing worker-home threads retaining their home during allowed sandbox changes, and a serde round trip pinning workspaceWriteSandbox.
